answer_text: Default BFD timers: IPsec sites use 1000 ms transmit, 1000 ms receive with a multiplier of 5. Cloud Interconnect sites use 500 ms transmit, 500 ms receive with a multiplier of 3. After you change BFD timers, you should re-establish the BFD session to apply the new values, since BFD timers are negotiated when a BFD session is established (enable/configure BFD in the Cato Management Application and on the remote peer to establish the session).
